responsibility: This module provides GCC’s cross-cutting debugging, dump, and instrumentation support used throughout the compiler pipeline to observe, control, and record compiler behavior. Its core dump infrastructure manages -fdump-* and -fopt-info output, per-pass dump files, dump contexts, and structured optimization records; the optinfo and JSON components turn optimization messages and pass metadata into machine-readable records, including saved optimization reports. Complementing that, the graph and graphviz families generate visual and generic graph representations for CFG and analysis dumps, while the debug-counter subsystem lets developers selectively enable transformation events for bug isolation. The module also supplies compiler-introspection utilities for per-pass statistics collection and timing reports, plus JSON parsing/serialization support needed by these reporting paths. Taken together, this is GCC’s shared observability and diagnostic-output subsystem rather than a language front end or optimizer proper.
